ICP Connect 2026-2027 - Call for scholarships

Provider: VLIR-UOS

Degree: Initial Master and Advanced Master programmes

Field of study: multiple study programmes including statistics and data science

Funding Type: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect scholarships cover tuition fees, travel, insurance and living expenses (board and lodging). We only offer scholarships for the full duration of the study programme.

Eligible countries: Benin, Bolivia, Burundi, Cambodia, Cameroon, Cuba, DR Congo, Ecuador, Ethiopia, Haiti, Indonesia, Kenya, Madagascar, Mali, Morocco, Mozambique, Nicaragua, Niger, Peru, Philippines, Rwanda, Senegal, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Vietnam, Zimbabwe

Country of study: Belgium

Eligibility criteria: Candidates must hold nationality from one of the 29 eligible countries and reside in any of these countries at the time of application. International applicants apply through the institution website.

Deadline: 28 February 2026
